tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search public opportunity data by text, classification, buyer, location, status, and dates.

tools.name: resolve_identifier
tools.description: Resolve notice, solicitation, award, PIID, UEI, CAGE, NAICS, PSC, or FAR identifiers with exact matches first.

tools.name: lookup_reference
tools.description: Search or retrieve NAICS, PSC, FAR, SBA size-standard, set-aside, or agency reference data.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one SAM.gov opportunity by notice ID with GovGazette and official source links.

tools.name: get_opportunity_brief
tools.description: Get a bounded, source-backed response decision brief with deadline status, fit signals, requirements, submission facts, changes, market evidence, and documents.

tools.name: get_opportunity_comps
tools.description: Get historical comparable public awards. Results are not an independent cost estimate or win odds.

tools.name: get_award_evidence
tools.description: Separate an official notice awardee, linked prior award recipients, and market participants without claiming an incumbent.

tools.name: search_awards
tools.description: Search the selected hot award dataset by award, recipient, agency, classification, place, dates, and value.

tools.name: get_award
tools.description: Get one award from the selected hot award dataset.

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Search current public SAM entities by name, UEI, CAGE, status, location, or primary NAICS.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: Get a public vendor or awardee record by 12-character UEI.

tools.name: get_vendor_awards
tools.description: Get public award history for one vendor UEI.

tools.name: get_opportunity_changes
tools.description: Get sanitized immutable changes with separate source and detection times.

tools.name: search_exclusions
tools.description: Check the current public exclusion snapshot by exact UEI or CAGE, or cautious name search. This is not a compliance certification.

tools.name: get_opportunity_extracted
tools.description: Get exact citations, requirements, costs, dates, forms, and submission text extracted without an LLM.

tools.name: search_extracted_facts
tools.description: Search exact source-backed facts extracted from official opportunity descriptions.

tools.name: get_opportunity_documents
tools.description: List current public SAM attachments with official external download links and links to published untrusted plain-text chunks when available. Raw binaries are not proxied.

tools.name: find_recompetes
tools.description: Find awards whose period-of-performance dates suggest a possible recompete. Results are inferences, not confirmed solicitations.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Summarize selected public award and opportunity signals for a market slice.

tools.name: get_watch_status
tools.description: Read connected-account searches, pursuits, award or vendor watches, and recompete radars. Requires OAuth and never changes a watch.

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Read the confirmed business identity, capability preferences, public SAM evidence, and selected-award coverage. Requires profile-read permission.

tools.name: get_business_defaults
tools.description: Get deterministic opportunity, award, recompete, market, and exclusion defaults from the connected business profile.

tools.name: search_opportunities_for_business
tools.description: Rank open opportunities against the connected business profile with transparent reasons. This is not a win probability.

tools.name: assess_opportunity_for_business
tools.description: Compare source-backed opportunity facts with the connected business profile without claiming eligibility or win odds.

tools.name: get_business_awards
tools.description: Get selected-hot award history for the confirmed profile UEI with explicit coverage limits.

tools.name: find_recompetes_for_business
tools.description: Find inferred recompete candidates across profile markets. Results are not confirmed solicitations.

tools.name: get_business_market
tools.description: Get selected public market summaries for profile classifications, agencies, and target states.

tools.name: check_business_exclusions
tools.description: Run an exact UEI exclusion lookup for the connected business. This is not a compliance certification.

tools.name: save_opportunity_search
tools.description: Save a federal opportunity search and choose its alert cadence.

tools.name: update_saved_search
tools.description: Change or disable a saved search in the connected GovGazette account.

tools.name: track_opportunity
tools.description: Add or replace one tracked opportunity and its next action in the connected account.

tools.name: update_tracked_opportunity
tools.description: Change or disable a tracked opportunity in the connected account.

tools.name: watch_award
tools.description: Watch a selected public award for material changes and activity.

tools.name: watch_vendor
tools.description: Watch public award activity for one exact vendor UEI.

tools.name: update_award_watch
tools.description: Change, pause, or resume an award or vendor watch.

tools.name: save_recompete_radar
tools.description: Save a rolling radar for awards entering an inferred recompete window.

tools.name: update_recompete_radar
tools.description: Change, pause, or resume a recompete radar.

tools.name: preview_business_profile_update
tools.description: Preview exact changes to capabilities and target markets before applying them.

tools.name: apply_business_profile_update
tools.description: Apply the exact business-profile patch returned by a recent preview.
